findings: Changing the idempotency-key format can cause requests that were previously deduplicated under `${orderId}:${attemptNumber}` to be treated as new operations under `${orderId}|${attemptNumber}`, risking duplicate checkout creation/charge during retries or deployments.
evidence: The only change replaces ':' with '|' in the generated idempotency key.
